name: pi-Flow outer loop and substep integrator (full read, replaces name-level piflow-policy-sampler)
plain: A pi-Flow model outputs a small closed-form velocity function, the policy, instead of one velocity. One model call per step gives that policy; the sampler then runs many Euler substeps through it with no further model calls. The diffusion_coefficient setting optionally adds noise by stopping the policy short of the target and adding noise to land on it. It has no CFG: the guider is set to cfg 1 and only positive conditioning is used.
math:
Outer: raw t = linspace(1, (f−1)/(N+f−1), N, no endpoint).clamp(≥0)·denoise, f=final_step_size_scale; σ=warp_t(raw t), then 0.
Substeps: count=⌈(raw_start−raw_end)·total_substeps⌉≥1. So total_substeps is per unit of raw t, shared between steps, not per step.
x←x+π(x,σ)·(σ⁻−σ), with σ⁻=warp_t(raw t−Δ). Mask: u=π·m+(x−y)/σ·(1−m).
Noise: m_h=(σ_to(1−σ_src)/(σ_src(1−σ_to)))^(h²), h=diffusion_coefficient. σ_dst=σ_to m_h/((1−σ_to)+σ_to m_h).
x_to=((1−σ_to)+σ_to m_h)x_dst+σ_to√(1−m_h²)·n. h=0 gives m_h=1, deterministic.
GM temperature: auto=clamp(0.1(N−1),0,1), applied on every step but the last, and only if the policy has temperature_.
